issues: No integrity problems: the leaf one-hot encoder and the logistic regression are fit only on training data; test labels are never used; no file or network access.
Minor: the logistic regression learns from leaves of a boosting model fit on the same training rows, so it can overfit. This is a modelling weakness, not a bug.
Candidate 0.0966 (1 run) vs incumbent 0.0893 (2 runs): 0.0073 worse. Recomputed z = -0.0073/(0.0049*sqrt(1+1/2)) = -1.216, which matches the harness value of -1.215. Rejection is consistent.
Adds code and a third model with no gain, which goes against 'simpler is better'.
